label: S1 reached at D2, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the state input is S1 (100% of activations; never at D1/GO, never on S2). Within S1-D2 steps (rate 18%) it is strongly gated by episode time: rate rises steeply over the last ~20 trials (trials 90-99 hold 61% of mass) and it co-varies with low model value (value < 5.22 gives precision 0.85, recall 0.44), so it probably reflects an internal clock / end-of-episode signal that falls in value. It is stronger after a common a1->S1 transition (88% of mass) than a rare a2->S1 transition. Weaker scattered activations at S1-D2 earlier in the episode (incl. trials 1-2) are missed. Restricting to ep_trial >= 80 gives F1 0.63 / mass recall 0.78 on dev; adding value or action terms did not improve it. Uses only observed variables.
